info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Facilities Utilities Administration By Utilities Administration Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows authorized users to modify details related to banking facilities under the utilities administration. It streamlines the management of utility administration records by enabling updates to specific entries identified by their unique ID. Typical consumers include financial institutions and utility service providers seeking to enhance their service delivery and maintain accurate records. The functionality supports seamless integration into existing systems for improving operational efficiency and compliance.
